hysteresis.note: This is the current separation a latched comparator needs to release if hysteresis is the only mechanism. The binding figure is band_min_a, not the nominal one. It must be compared against measured noise and CSA settling residue, neither of which is characterised here.

unbounded_terms: CSA midpoint bias has no specified tolerance
shunt and offset thermal drift not characterised over range
trip latency between threshold crossing and latch not budgeted
low-side shunt blind during high-side conduction (register OC-04)
common reference fault not covered by a rail-tolerance term
safety_claim_reason: The static envelope is computable but a guaranteed trip point is not: five terms above are unbounded, so no current can be claimed safe to reach without damage. Register OC-03 stays open until midpoint error is bounded and thermal drift is characterised.
